The '''Nixor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Eclorar sector/Legends|Eclorar sector]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nixor/Legends|Nixor]]. It was the location of the decrepit [[Nixor Spaceport]] around the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
